items.name: Minnesota Meetup Wednesday 2023
items.information:
# This competition has been cancelled. Please check your email for more details.

This competition will be held on **Wednesday, January 11th** starting at 5:30 pm and will go throughout the evening. First-timers are encouraged to register!

This competition is a series competition with [Minnesota Meetup Monday 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupMonday2023) and Minnesota [Meetup Tuesday 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupTuesday2023). Please see the Series Competitions tab for more information. 

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
